buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Service Required. Labour/ Mazdoor (Housekeeper/ Messkeeper) Procurement of outsourcing services is felt necessary to relieve combatant personnel presently employed on routine/ non core duties, thereby optimising combatant manpower

for their primary military duties & ensuring efficient and uninterrupted functioning of the non core duties. 2. Service Provided. Services will be provide by service provider from the date of finalized by buyer till end of contractual period. 3. Working Hours. Working hours will be 0600hrs to 1000hrs and 1600hrs to 2000hrs Six days per week. Monday to Saturday will be observed as working days and Sunday will be closed day. Working hours will have lunch break of one hour and one tea brak of 15 minutes. Holiday will be subject to work and shall decided by the buyer. 4. Reporting Sick. Any reporting sick of outsourced manpower will be the responsibility of service provider interms of medical treatment and provision of replacement. If any outsourced manpower worked for half day, no payment will be made for those working hous. 5. Transportation. Transportation of the outsourced manpower to 611 EME Bn RAPID (H) and back will be the responsibility of the service provider. The services provider shall ensure that the outsourced manpower is available on designated time. 6. Attendance. Outsourced manpower will do the entry both on arrival and departure at 611 EME Bn RAPID (H) Main Gate and an attendance register will be maintained to rule out any discrepancy at later stage. Outsourcing person will be paid as per attendance marked on daily basis. 7. Food. Food and tea will be either provided by the services provided or brought by the work force. This unit does not have any canteen facility for the same. Individual shall not be permitted to leave the unit premises during the working hours. 8. Dress. All individual must have a common dress le Blue Dangree and shall be arranged by service provider. No separate allowance will be given for the uniform by the buyer including any washing or miscellaneous charges. 9. Age. Age of the individual must be between 18 to 40 years. 10. Payment. Payment towards the outsourcing services will be paid as per the latest nerrick rate by the Govt. All overheads like ESI, EPF, PF etc will be exclusive in the amount fixed by the Govt. he current Nerrick rate of Ahmedabad is 827 per day. The payment will be made to the servie provider on monthly basis as per monthly attendance of the individuals. 11. Death. In case of naturale death of any individual during working hours there will not be any liability of buyer. His must will not be responsible in any way of compensation. 3. Manpower Replacement Clause. In case any deployed manpower 1 remains absent on any day due to any reason, the service provider ensure that a suitable replacement is provided on the same day to maintain uninterrupted services. No additional payment shall be made for the replacement manpower.

14. Multiple L1s. In case of multiple L1 vendors, the Buyer will select any one of the L1 vendors as per the applicable GeM Guidelines and prevailing policy of outsourcing. . 2. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider
